summary: Khôra: Rise of an Empire is a dice-driven city-building game where each turn you pick two of seven possible actions, constrained by your dice roll, and climb economy, culture, and military tracks to unlock stronger options. It's a tight, quick-turn engine-building race with a Greek city-state theme layered over fairly abstract track advancement.
praised: brisk turns keep the game moving
criticised: theme feels pasted onto the mechanisms
results can swing on dice rolls
compared unfavorably as derivative of other engine-builders by some reviewers

interaction.detail: Players advance along common economy, culture, and military tracks and can be first to claim limited achievements, but most of a turn is spent managing your own dice results and resources somewhat independently of opponents.

subsystems: advancing Culture/Military/Economy tracks for endgame VP
unlocking achievement tiles for milestone VP
scoring.how_you_win: Take paired actions each turn to climb the Culture, Military, and Economy tracks and unlock achievements; once a player triggers the endgame condition, total VP from track positions and achievements decides the winner.
